summary: Clarify synced read positions' claim-registry compatibility digest impact

replay.detail: No additional replay beyond the read_positions initialization and rebuild documented in synced-read-positions.json.

schema.detail: No additional database layout change beyond the read_positions projection documented in synced-read-positions.json.

rules.detail: Correction to synced-read-positions.json: adding the read-position subject and claim changes the claim-registry digest and therefore the projection compatibility digest. No checkpoint rules version transition is introduced. Existing mismatched-registry guards suppress graph healing while signed log admission continues; this is not a requirement to deploy every daemon together.

compatibility.detail: Members with different claim vocabularies retain the existing registry mismatch restrictions, including identity operations that require matching fleet registries. Capability-aware clients use read-positions v1 only when advertised. Mixed-old/new member convergence and swap-back have not been exercised; do not assume binary replacement removes accepted new claims.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the unmeasured normal restart and projection initialization documented in synced-read-positions.json.

manual.detail: No additional manual migration or re-pairing. Complete the normal rolling upgrade before requesting operations guarded on matching member registries.

recovery.detail: Mixed-version swap-back has not been verified. Preserve claims and identity, and roll forward to a build recognizing read-position.advanced if an older build cannot process the new vocabulary.
